selects only its control's new cases: 0 on the untouched tree); the class's listing and the root binaries under the
`mutants` profile; the two r2 refusal reads; the two dedupe counts; the host read; the whole unit, integration and e2e
layers through the harness; then the operator pass.

**What is not run, and why:** no round, no live entry and no live start; the one mutation run is step 8's, a plan
step outside the block behind its announced stop (testing.md 2026-10-04: a block holds no mutation entry). Its
record is read after it by the `addendum` probe, which carries no `artifact`: step 8 produces it. No `cargo deny`

test-owned home. Every new wait is bounded below the 12 s root wait and the 15 s `mutants` kill (the pump cases: 1.5 s

own filtered entry (its label below), its case named, `--timeout 600` (a clone build of the crate plus its few
cases). Each case fails on its own bounded assertion, so a `timeout` reading would NOT read the guard as held. Each
`old` is anchored on the site's whole line, since `now() >= deadline` also stands inside `Instant::now() >= deadline`
elsewhere in `pump.rs`.
